body: SEBI interim order 3 Jul 2025: ₹4,843.5 cr impounded; alleged net India profit ₹36,502 cr Jan 2023–Mar 2025 (options +₹43,289 cr). Alleged: buy BankNifty stocks in morning while building larger short options, sell later; marking the close. Ban lifted ~18 Jul 2025 after escrow. SAT reserved order 21 Oct 2026; no final ruling as of Nov 2026.
title: Jane Street SEBI order (Bank Nifty expiry)
